description: Fetch the full public menu for a restaurant — categories, products, prices, option groups, allergens, nutrition. Use this to build the cart you pass to place_order. PUBLIC tool, no auth required. Each product carries `option_groups` (id, name, required, min_select, max_select, options[{id, name, price_delta}]); pass the chosen option ids as items[].modifier_option_ids to place_order or to create_cart (the anonymous cart the guest confirms) — a required group must be filled or the order or cart is refused. `allergen_codes` are EU 1169/2011 Annex II keys (gluten, crustaceans, eggs, fish, peanuts, soy, milk, nuts, celery, mustard, sesame, sulphites, lupin, molluscs) given ONLY when the venue's allergen name matches the regulation list exactly; a venue-specific allergen appears in `allergens` without a code. Allergen lists come from the venue (or were AI-suggested and then saved by the venue where `allergen_disclosure.source` says so). `allergen_disclosure.as_of` is when the venue last edited the item record, not a verification date. Follow the top-level `disclosure.agent_instructions`; show `disclosure.text` to the guest in their language whenever an allergen or dietary question comes up; `dietary_flags` only ever warn (true) — null is unknown, never "free of".
name: get_restaurant_menu
title: Restaurant menu
